author: reek
body: `int-mod x n` is bounded by [0, n - 1]. The emit-side prover always knew that; the checker did not, because it resolved builtins through a table of CONSTANT intervals and this bound depends on an argument. So these three functions were REFUSED with CDX2051 quoting the full i64 interval -- a provable bounded return that could not be written without __narrow, which reintroduces the runtime trap the bound exists to discharge.

author: reek
body: Compiling at all is the test. Each function is also printed, so a range derived wrongly in the other direction changes an answer rather than passing quietly.
